answer: A lagoon drip starves fake identities: payouts pool in a lagoon and drain over fourteen days, so bids above ten units wait for a clean drip. Every identity sits on a public nebula map; two sharing three clients in a month form a nebula that freezes both until two peers audit one drip with its client within a day. A forged drip, shared nebula, or early drain burns a 32-unit bond in a vault; 100 fakes need 100 vaults and risk 3,200 units.
